evals.prompt: Ingest raw source document raw/auth-spec.md into the wiki, update related entities, glossary, and index.
evals.expected_output: Summary page in wiki/sources/auth-spec.md with YAML frontmatter, updated wiki/index.md, updated wiki/glossary.md, and an append entry in wiki/log.md.
assertions: Does not modify the source document in raw/
Creates a source summary page in wiki/sources/ with YAML frontmatter (title, type, created, updated, sources, tags)
Appends an activity entry to wiki/log.md

evals.prompt: Run a lint inspection on the wiki to check for contradictions, orphan pages, and broken references.
evals.expected_output: A structured lint report detailing broken links, orphan pages, terminology conflicts, and proposed fixes.
assertions: Reports orphan pages with no inbound links
Checks for terminology consistency against wiki/glossary.md
Proposes concrete fixes before applying changes
